# CurlToCode

> CurlToCode is a private, browser-based HTTP request converter for cURL and source code. Conversion is static and entirely client-side: the site never executes, uploads, or sends the requests users paste.

## Main pages

- [Converter](https://curltocode.com/): Convert cURL to 71 generator targets across 37 language and format families, or statically parse supported source code back to cURL.
- [All converters](https://curltocode.com/converters): Browse every supported forward generator and reverse parser.
- [About CurlToCode](https://curltocode.com/about): Product architecture, privacy model, and project scope.

## cURL to code — scripting and web languages

- [cURL to Python](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-python): Requests, HTTPX, aiohttp, http.client, and urllib3.
- [cURL to JavaScript](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-javascript): Fetch, Axios, Undici, jQuery, and XMLHttpRequest.
- [cURL to TypeScript](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-typescript): Typed Fetch, Axios, and Undici output.
- [cURL to Node.js](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-nodejs): Fetch, Axios, Got, Ky, SuperAgent, and node:https, including file bodies from disk.
- [cURL to PHP](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-php): cURL extension, Guzzle, Symfony HttpClient, and Laravel HTTP.
- [cURL to Ruby](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-ruby): Net::HTTP, Faraday, HTTParty, and REST Client.
- [cURL to Perl](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-perl): LWP::UserAgent.
- [cURL to PowerShell](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-powershell): Invoke-RestMethod and Invoke-WebRequest.

## cURL to code — compiled and JVM languages

- [cURL to Go](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-go): net/http and Resty.
- [cURL to Rust](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-rust): reqwest and ureq.
- [cURL to Java](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-java): JDK HttpClient, OkHttp, Apache HttpClient 5, and HttpURLConnection.
- [cURL to Kotlin](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-kotlin): OkHttp and Ktor.
- [cURL to C#](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-csharp): HttpClient, RestSharp, and Flurl.
- [cURL to Scala](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-scala): sttp.
- [cURL to C](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-c): libcurl easy interface.
- [cURL to C++](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-cpp): C++ Requests (cpr).
- [cURL to Nim](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-nim): std/httpclient.
- [cURL to Crystal](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-crystal): HTTP::Client.

## cURL to code — mobile platforms

- [cURL to Swift](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-swift): URLSession and Alamofire.
- [cURL to Objective-C](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-objectivec): NSURLSession.
- [cURL to Dart](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-dart): package:http and Dio, for Flutter clients.

## cURL to code — functional, data, and scientific languages

- [cURL to Clojure](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-clojure): clj-http.
- [cURL to Elixir](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-elixir): Req and HTTPoison.
- [cURL to OCaml](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-ocaml): Cohttp with Lwt.
- [cURL to R](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-r): httr2 and httr.
- [cURL to Julia](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-julia): HTTP.jl.
- [cURL to Lua](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-lua): lua-http.
- [cURL to MATLAB](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-matlab): matlab.net.http.
- [cURL to CFML](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-cfml): cfhttp for ColdFusion and Lucee.

## cURL to CLIs, formats, and automation

- [cURL to HTTPie](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-httpie): The HTTPie command line equivalent of a cURL command.
- [cURL to Wget](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-wget): The Wget command line equivalent, with its multipart limitation stated.
- [cURL to raw HTTP](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-http): The HTTP/1.1 request message the command would put on the wire.
- [cURL to HAR](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-har): A HAR 1.2 log entry for tooling that consumes HAR.
- [cURL to JSON](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-json): A lossless JSON description of the normalized request.
- [cURL to Postman](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-postman): A Postman v2.1 collection containing the request.
- [cURL to Ansible](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-ansible): An ansible.builtin.uri task.
- [cURL to k6](https://curltocode.com/curl-to-k6): A k6 load test script.

## Code to cURL — static reverse parsing

Every reverse page reads source as an abstract syntax tree or a structured
document rather than running it. A value that only exists at runtime is
reported as an unresolved expression instead of being guessed at. 52 of the 71
generator targets can be read back this way, across 20 languages and formats.

- [JavaScript to cURL](https://curltocode.com/javascript-to-curl): Fetch, Axios, Undici, jQuery, and XMLHttpRequest.
- [TypeScript to cURL](https://curltocode.com/typescript-to-curl): Fetch, Axios, and Undici.
- [Node.js to cURL](https://curltocode.com/nodejs-to-curl): Fetch, Axios, Got, Ky, SuperAgent, and node:https.
- [Python to cURL](https://curltocode.com/python-to-curl): Requests, HTTPX, aiohttp, http.client, and urllib3.
- [PHP to cURL](https://curltocode.com/php-to-curl): cURL extension, Guzzle, Symfony HttpClient, and Laravel HTTP.
- [Go to cURL](https://curltocode.com/go-to-curl): net/http and Resty.
- [Java to cURL](https://curltocode.com/java-to-curl): JDK HttpClient, OkHttp, Apache HttpClient 5, and HttpURLConnection.
- [Kotlin to cURL](https://curltocode.com/kotlin-to-curl): OkHttp and Ktor.
- [C# to cURL](https://curltocode.com/csharp-to-curl): HttpClient, RestSharp, and Flurl.
- [Ruby to cURL](https://curltocode.com/ruby-to-curl): Net::HTTP, Faraday, HTTParty, and rest-client.
- [Rust to cURL](https://curltocode.com/rust-to-curl): reqwest and ureq.
- [Swift to cURL](https://curltocode.com/swift-to-curl): URLSession and Alamofire.
- [Dart to cURL](https://curltocode.com/dart-to-curl): package:http and Dio.
- [HTTP to cURL](https://curltocode.com/http-to-curl): A raw HTTP/1.1 request message.
- [HTTPie to cURL](https://curltocode.com/httpie-to-curl): An HTTPie command line.
- [Wget to cURL](https://curltocode.com/wget-to-curl): A Wget command line.
- [PowerShell to cURL](https://curltocode.com/powershell-to-curl): Invoke-RestMethod and Invoke-WebRequest.
- [HAR to cURL](https://curltocode.com/har-to-curl): A HAR entry exported from browser DevTools.
- [Postman to cURL](https://curltocode.com/postman-to-curl): A Postman collection request.
- [JSON to cURL](https://curltocode.com/json-to-curl): A JSON request description.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://curltocode.com/privacy): How hosting and advertising data are handled; converter content is excluded.
- [Terms of Service](https://curltocode.com/terms): Usage terms and generated-code limitations.
